name: highway_diagonal_cloverleaf
author: sc3kre
description: Task hwdx: a diagonal highway crossing a straight highway at 45 degrees becomes a skewed cloverleaf (the straight bridges over the diagonal; four loops for the left turns, four outer ramps for the right turns), per quadrant where the land is free. Rule in sc3netmod_hwdx.c, tables from re/tools/netmod/hwdx.py, art from hwdx_paint.py.
